0.x: **After the Sungas came the Kanvas**; both were **Brahmins**.
**Most powerful dynasty in the south after the Mauryas:** the **Satavahanas**; the Puranas say they defeated the Sungas and Kanvas; **Satakarni I** is said to have defeated Pushyamitra.
**Magadhan order:** **Haryanka (544–412 BC) → Shishunaga → Nanda (344–321 BC) → Maurya → Sunga → Kanva**; sequence Maurya – Sunga – Kanva – **Kushana**.
